label: sdc01_0090_bbteacher_01
text: Morning, everyone! Did you sleep well?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0090_bbteacher_02
text: Starting today, you’ll be joined by our two\nstudents from Blueberry Academy.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0090_bbteacher_03
text: Go on, kids! Time to introduce yourselves.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0090_sister_01
text: Hi! I’m Carmine![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0090_sister_02
text: It’s a pleasure to meet all you outsiders—I mean,\nvisitors from Paldea! Hee hee![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_01
text: Carmine and Kieran actually grew up here, so ask\nthem for help if you need anything.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_02
text: And you two had better be of real help, you\nhear me?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_sister_03
text: Aye-aye.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_03
text: Now that that’s settled... Why don’t I tell you all\na bit about what we have planned for you?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_04
text: This school trip of yours will be an exercise in\norienteering![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_05
text: First, we’ll have you split into pairs. Then each\npair will be tasked with finding [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]three signboards[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\r\nlocated around the land of Kitakami.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_06
text: On each signboard, you’ll find snippets of an\nold folktale passed down here in Kitakami.\r\nRead them all and learn a bit about our home.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_07
text: To prove you’ve completed the task, we ask that\neach pair take a snapshot together in front of\r\nthese signboards with their phone or camera.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_08
text: Take a photo together in front of each of the\nthree signboards to complete your mission![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_09
text: It’s a self-guided tour of Kitakami! Learn all\nabout its rich history![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_10
text: Much more fun than sitting around and listening\nto me ramble on and on, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_bbteacher_04
text: Wonderful! What an innovative idea for a group\nactivity![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_11
text: Oh, and I’ve got a gift for each of you as well![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_12
text: I hear these things’re all the rage in the big cities.\nUse them when you take those photos![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_14
text: I’ll even teach you a rad pose I came up with all\non my own.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_system_01
text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Eureka emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from the\ncaretaker!

label: sdc01_0090_bbteacher_05
text: Ah, yes. Real...rad...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0090_bbteacher_06
text: Remember that one of the goals of this trip is to\ndeepen the ties between our two schools.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0090_bbteacher_07
text: It seems like having someone who knows the\narea well would be a big help. That being said...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0090_bbteacher_08
text: Let’s try to maximize the number of interschool\npairs, OK? Time to mingle![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0090_caretaker_13
text: Be sure to tell me if Carmine or Kieran cause\nyou any trouble during your stay.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0090_student1_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]We’ve got four students from [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0206)]NaranjUva Academy
and
only two from Blueberry...\c
So that means at least one pair will be made up
of just kids from our school, right?

label: sdc01_0090_student2_01
text: That girl, Carmine... I’m not sure I trust that\ncheery greeting from her.

label: sdc01_0090_student3_01
text: What?! I don’t want to have to pair up with\nsomeone I don’t even know!

label: sdc01_0090_stopper_01
text: Try talking to the other kids! It’s time to make\nsome new friends!
